# Function inventory for the Wolfram Physics guide

Master inventory of every function, paclet, notebook, post and paper named in the sixteen research files of this directory, merged by (name, source) and sorted into the sections of the WolframInstitute/WolframPhysics guide page. Built by scratchpad/build_inventory.py on 2026-09-17; the row counts below are re-derived on every run.

## Method

Dated 2026-09-17. Sixteen research files came out of a multi-source sweep (built-in Wolfram Language, the Function Repository by contributor and by keyword, the Paclet Repository and paclets, GitHub and source code, the Wolfram Institute, the PureMath paclet modules, the nikm cloud deployment, the cloud program files, Stephen Wolfram's writings before and from 2020, the Summer School projects and papers, Wolfram Community, the wolframphysics.org site and its archive notebooks, plus the round-2 named gaps), each verified by evaluation in a WL 15.0 kernel and by fetching the page or file it cites, then one critic round with follow-up finders, then this normalization: every table row of every research file was rewritten as a record with name, kind, source, url, description, section, tier, status and note, and the records were merged here by (name, source), keeping the longest description, the strongest tier (core over secondary over omit), the most specific section (a guide section beats Not for the guide), the status unconfirmed only when every record says so, and the union of the notes. The archives report (wolframphysics-archives-notebooks.md) was cut off mid-way through a rate-limited bulk download of the notebooks and stands unverified; its rows are included as they were normalized. A description or note that carried a pipe now carries a slash, a token with a backtick or a dollar sign is written as a code span, and a dollar sign in a URL is percent-encoded. No function was invented: every row traces to a research file, and the Sources section gives the count each file contributed.
